payload.rebuttal: fixed: The parent-branch lookup matched a task by pushed_sha, then threw that match away and re-fetched the newest task of the same spec_id, which could be a different, later task. Changed it to look up the exact task_id that matched, and added a test where that same spec gets a later re-run with a different pushed sha, so a buggy fallback to 'newest of the spec' would name the wrong branch.
